sources.title: Axion1-0/Axion-1.0-35B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository provides a reproduction checkpoint of Axion 1.0-35B, following the recipe described in Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified. The model is designed for scientific reasoning, information seeking, and tool-augmented problem solving.

sources.title: Axion 1.0: Open Agent Foundation Models, Simplified
sources.snippet: We introduce Axion 1.0, a fully open agent foundation model that combines strong and broad agentic capabilities with a remarkably simple training recipe. Axion 1.0 is trained in only three stages: two lightweight supervised fine-tuning stages followed by reinforcement learning, without dedicated mid-training, direct preference optimization (DPO), or on-policy distillation (OPD).
